prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed two vehicles at rest in the center of the travel lanes with visible front-end and driver-side damage. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling straight through the intersection on the green signal when Driver 2 turned left across their path, striking the side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they began the left turn when the signal allowed and did not see Driver 1 approaching until impact. A passenger was seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and stated they would seek medical evaluation. Both drivers were able to exit their vehicles under their own power. Skid marks were noted from Driver 1's vehicle leading into the impact area. Traffic was diverted around the scene until both vehicles were removed. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to yield the right-of-way.
